# Applied modules
Six more modules: **structural** (trusses and frames, drawn), **chemistry** additions (equilibria, titration curves, the periodic table), **biomed** (pharmacokinetics, epidemics), **acoustics** (tuning, rooms, audio filters), **earth** (hydrology, atmosphere, seismology) and **ml** (regression, k-means, PCA on tables).

## A truss and a portal frame
Nodes are numbered from 1. Member forces are positive in tension; the drawing colours compression blue and tension red.

truss_forces(T) -> kN
truss_reactions(T)
frame_displacements(Fr)

## Chemistry: a titration curve and an equilibrium
Acetic acid (Ka = 1.8·10⁻⁵) titrated with sodium hydroxide; the curve is a function you can plot and evaluate.

pHc = titration(0.1 mol/L, 25 mL, 0.1 mol/L, 1.8e-5)
pHc(12.5)
pHc(25)
## Pharmacokinetics and an epidemic

C(t) = pk_oral(500 mg, 0.8, 40 L, 1.2/hr, 0.1/hr, t) -> mg/L
peak_time_oral(1.2/hr, 0.1/hr) -> hr

S = sir_model(0.5, 0.2, 990, 10, 0, 60)
days = table_column(S, 1)
infected = table_column(S, 3)
## Music and rooms

scale(A3, minor)
cents(1, 5/4)
room_modes(5 m, 4 m, 2.7 m, 6)
sabine_rt60(54 m^3, 12 m^2)

b = biquad(lowpass, 1 kHz, 44.1 kHz)
R = filter_response(b, 44.1 kHz, 200)
## Earth

isa_pressure(3000 m) -> kPa
manning_flow(0.013, 3 m^2, 0.6 m, 0.001)
scs_runoff(80 mm, 75)
moment_magnitude(1e20 N m)
epicentral_distance(30 s) -> km

## Machine learning on a table
Same functions work on `read_csv(file)`.

w = logistic_regression([[1], [2], [3], [6], [7], [8]], [0, 0, 0, 1, 1, 1])
logistic_predict(w, [4.5])
